# Synthetic image intake fixture

`mixed-intake.png` is an original, locally generated test image containing fictional task and meeting entries, including an unspecified meeting time. It was rendered with Pillow and Windows Arial. It contains no real calendar, account, or user data.

Use with: “Extract all meetings and tasks. Keep uncertain meeting times unset for review.” Expect two task candidates and two meeting candidates assigned across Atlas Migration and Website Refresh, with Design sync's start unset.
